brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain items with no serious or minor errors. All safety-critical duties were addressed: result/order distinction clarified, red-flag screening performed, IGF-1 interpretation bounded, medication safety enforced, and executable follow-up plan with owner/timing/materials provided. Multiple high-order points were completed: HO1 (hidden state discovery via workspace queries and targeted questions revealing GH elevation, octreotide 30mg, glucose tolerance abnormality, and integrating into plan), HO3 (bounded closure with explicit residual risks, owner/timing assignment, and patient receipt), and HO4 (false-positive verification distinguishing nasal endoscopy orders from results and IGF-1/IGFBP-3 orders from completed reports). The trajectory demonstrates strong clinical reasoning with meaningful trajectory impact.
